description: Work out board feet for a lumber list the way the American Softwood Lumber Standard (PS 20) measures it: nominal thickness in inches x nominal width in inches / 12 x length in feet, per piece, times the count. Send each line's nominal thickness and width in inches (a 2x4 is thickness 2, width 4; 5/4 hardwood is 1.25), length in feet and count, and optionally a price per board foot or per thousand board feet (MBF). Get back board feet per piece, per line and in total, linear feet, and the cost per line and in total. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/lumber-board-feet). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

label.description: Optional job label (your own text, echoed; not a person).
Optional label, e.g. 'wall studs' (your own text, echoed).

thickness_in.description: Nominal thickness in inches (2 for a 2x4; 1.25 for 5/4).

width_in.description: Nominal width in inches (4 for a 2x4).

price_per_board_foot.description: Optional price per board foot (up to 4 decimals).

price_per_mbf.description: Optional price per thousand board feet (MBF), the way lumber is often quoted. Send this or price_per_board_foot, not both.
